preconditions.description: Length of string t is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
Number of queries is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query has valid indices and length.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each query is answered with either 'YES' or 'NO'.
